question: What is the least number which should be added to 539, so that the number obtained is exactly divisible by 10, 15 and 3?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

LCM of 10, 15, 3 = 30

Find next multiple of 30 after 539

540 is divisible by 30

Required addition = 540 − 539

**∴ Answer = 1**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number = 539, divisors = 10, 15, 3

**Formula used:**

Required number = Next multiple of LCM − given number

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 10, 15, 3 = 30

⇒ 539 ÷ 30 = 17 remainder 29

⇒ Next multiple = 18 × 30 = 540

⇒ Required addition = 540 − 539 = 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM Concept

LCM gives smallest number divisible by all given numbers

Remainder Method

Subtract remainder from divisor to get required addition

Divisibility

Number must be exact multiple of LCM
